title.rendered: What is a Laser Hair Growth Cap?

content.rendered:
Are you struggling with hair loss and looking for a way to retrieve those beautiful hair follicles you once loved? You are not alone!

In this post we are going to discuss the details of the Kiierr laser hair growth cap, and how it can help you combat your hair loss!

What is a Laser Cap?

Laser caps are FDA-cleared medical devices that use low level light therapy (also known as LLLT) to stimulate blood flow in the scalp tissue. With increased blood flow, the vital nutrients and oxygen are able to reach the hair follicles to encourage new growth.

These devices also improve cellular respiration and reduce inflammation in the scalps of men and women to support a healthy head of hair.

Scientific studies have demonstrated that this technology produces thicker and healthier hair. Both the studies and governing certifications attest to its safety and effectiveness.

The convenient and portable use of laser caps make them a phenomenal, non-invasive hair growth option.

Kiierr Laser Cap for Hair Loss

Kiierr Laser Hair Caps use low-level laser light therapy to improve cellular respiration and function by stimulating the hair follicle cells. Better breathing cells make for a better functioning hair follicle and happier, healthier hair!

Kiierr Cap is backed by experts in the fields of science, medicine and technology. Optimal power and ease of use are at the heart of our cutting-edge technology. This gives our patients the best possible hair growth results. The Kiierr Cap is worn 30 minutes every other day at a time that is convenient for you! Customers typically see new hair growth potentially becoming noticeable in as little as 10-12 weeks. It can also be used in conjunction with other treatments, such as hair transplantation and others.

Kiierr vs Competitors

Kiierr laser hair growth caps use the same laser diode wavelength and output power per laser as many other FDA-cleared LLLT devices; however, it has 272 laser diodes. Most of our competitors’ devices have around 200 laser diodes and are, therefore, less effective. For the price, there is not another LLLT device on the market with 272 laser diodes.

Conclusion

Kiierr strives for customer hair growth success! With the use of the Kiierr laser cap and Kiierr hair growth supplements, your hair will be given the best chance to thrive! Start your hair growth journey with us today and kiss hair loss goodbye.

 

Take a look at our laser cap reviews page to see the amazing results our Kiierr customers have experienced!
